macro_context: Middle East supply risk from the Iran flare-up is lifting oil for a second straight week and pressuring the rupee via merchant hedging, even though India's 10-year bond posted its best day in over a week on mid-week oil relief. Q1 FY27 earnings season is the dominant swing factor: TCS's beat drove a Sensex/Nifty rally after a midweek rout, while Nifty IT broadly fell (Infosys, HCLTech, TCS among losers) as US Fed minutes revived rate-cut uncertainty.

names_in_play.catalyst: NSE 'Restructuring' regulatory filing (XBRL + PDF) posted 2026-07-10, content not yet reviewed - a material corporate-action disclosure on a current holding that needs follow-up before any add/trim decision. Jefferies separately flags 13% loan CAGR, 14% ROE and a $500M 5-yr bond; stock +4.2% this week.

Q1 FY27 results: net profit +5% YoY to Rs 13,349 crore, triggering a broad Sensex/Nifty rally after a midweek rout - though Nifty IT still lagged on Fed-minutes rate jitters, and hiring reportedly resumed.
Reliance Industries and Jio Financial announced their Q1 FY27 earnings dates (board meeting) - a scheduled event catalyst ahead of the print.
ICICI Securities Buy rating, target Rs 1,850; Nomura names it a top pick ahead of Q1 results (due Jul 18); MCLR cut 5bps effective Jul 7 (rate-transmission/margin watch) on this current holding.
KR Choksey Accumulate rating, target Rs 1531. ADRs rose after TCS's Q1 print, but Nifty IT sector broadly fell as Fed minutes revived rate jitters ahead of Infosys's own Q1 print.

macro_themes: Iran-driven oil/rupee stress is a swing risk for import-heavy and rate-sensitive names, not yet a directional trigger.
Q1 FY27 IT earnings season: TCS's beat set an initial positive tone but Nifty IT internals stay mixed pending INFY/HCLTech prints, with Fed minutes adding rate-path uncertainty.
Bank Q1 previews (Nomura, Jefferies) name HDFCBANK, ICICIBANK and Kotak as sector top picks ahead of results - a broad brokerage tailwind for private banks into earnings season.
